how can I center my banner I made so it stretches across the entire width without repeating?

You'll want to change this code:

#header {
 background: url(http://i.imgur.com/DeP29tB.jpg ) repeat scroll;
 height: 315px;
 background-position: 50% 25%;
}

To this:

#header {
 background: url(http://i.imgur.com/DeP29tB.jpg ) no-repeat scroll;
 height: 315px;
 background-position: 50% 25%;
 background-size: cover;
}

I would also recommend adjusting your graphic to better scale on larger resolutions, but that would have to be done in a photo editing app like photoshop or gimp.
